name: anuvritti-workspace
description: Anuvritti. The Python server, the design language, the typed client and the app, in one tree.

scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/world test && npm --prefix packages/client test && npm --prefix apps/anuvritti test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/world/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/anuvritti/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/anuvritti/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
